zone: "Asia/Seoul"  # requires k8s 1.27+ / minikube with TZ support; falls back to schedule above
"America/Bogota"   # Ajustar a la zona horaria deseada

expression: '0 3 * * *' # 03:00 daily — off-peak (ADR-018: the upload races home bandwidth)
zone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' # k8s >=1.27; without it the schedule is UTC

expression: "0 6 * * *" # Ejecuta todos los días a las 21:35 (UTC)
"0 2 4 * *"    # 02:00 WIB on the 4th of each month
"0 4 1 * *"          # 04:00 UTC on the 1st of each month
"*/5 * * * 1-5"  # 平日のみ5分間隔で実行
'33 4 * * *' # Restart Plex every day at 4:33am NY time
'33 5 * * *' # Restart warp every day at 5:33am NY time

zone: "Europe/Paris"        # k8s >= 1.27 honours this; image TZ is Paris too

expression: "* * * * *" # This cron job runs every minute
